ns2:course.label: Business Intelligence
ns2:course.description: This advanced course examines recent developments in information technology for managerial decision support with an emphasis on Internet-based and mobile information technologies. Real-world cases will be used to discuss the application of these technologies to management information systems. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Informatics or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
